record.question: Which of the following soil is most ideal for paddy cultivation?
record.explanation: Answer C: Alluvium soil. Alluvial soil is the best choice among the listed Indian soil groups: NCERT describes the alluvial northern plain as agriculturally productive, and ICAR’s Bihar profile records extensive rice cultivation on deep alluvial soils. This is a best-option statement, not a claim that rice cannot grow elsewhere. Reference: https://www.ncert.nic.in/textbook/pdf/iess102.pdf; https://www.icar.gov.in/en/node/17260. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
